verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs describe autonomous coding agents that can edit files, run terminal commands, and operate across editor/terminal/browser, but there is no evidence of any issue-tracker (e.g., GitHub Issues) integration or an end-to-end workflow that ingests a tracked issue and produces a pull request. Missing for 10: issue-tracker ingestion, automated branch/PR creation, and any documented GitHub/GitLab PR workflow example.
